pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert: AUTH.JWT.VERIFY.FAILURE | P1 | service=auth-service | error-rate spike 950/min at 11:07 UTC | routed to @natalie (primary) -> @ryan -> @jon-manag | https://pagerduty.example/INC-8721

incident-bot: Auto-page sent. Escalation timer: 4m

natalie: acked. Looking. Seeing a lot of `kid_mismatch` and `signature_invalid` messages. Collecting sample tokens and verifier logs.

ryan: joining. any region hotspots?

natalie: breakdown by region: us-west-1 ~72% of failures, eu-central ~18%, others negligible. Mobile clients show largest failure rate.

natalie: sample logs:
```
2026-03-15T11:07:05Z verifier ERROR signature_invalid token=tok-abc client=mobile-us-west kid=9f2d4a expected=[a1c3, b8d7]
2026-03-15T11:07:05Z verifier WARN kid_mismatch upstream_kids=[a1c3,b8d7] token_kid=9f2d4a
```

ops-bot: upstream key-change detected for issuer https://auth-sign.example/.well-known/jwks.json @ 11:06:48 UTC (new kid=9f2d4a)

lee: possible cause 14 recent key rotation at signing-service not reflected in our jwks mirror cluster. Could be a mirror lag or replication worker crash.

natalie: quick check of cached jwks on a failing node:
```bash
ssh auth-prod-west-12 'jq .keys[].kid /var/cache/jwks/auth.json'
"a1c3b2f1"
"b8d7c9e0"
```
Incoming tokens show kid `9f2d4a` which is missing.

tara-eng: I can publish a temporary mapping in verifier to accept the new kid -> use the active public key from signing-service, but that requires fetching the new key and enabling in prod. Risk: if key rotation was intentional and expected, we should prefer to fix replication instead of a manual accept.

jon-manag: key points: minimize customer impact; prefer short-lived manual accept keyed to the incident; ensure we capture why replication failed.

natalie: mitigation options: 
1) hot-add new kid to verifier (fast, low-risk)
2) trigger replication repair / restart (correct, may take longer)
3) failover to backup signing endpoint (if available)

ryan: recommend 1 then 2. add 1 for immediate relief and run replication fix in parallel.

jon-manag: approved. do it. coordinate with security for key provenance check.

natalie: fetching the new public key from signing-service and verifying fingerprint.
```bash
curl -s https://signing-service.internal/keys/9f2d4a | jq -c .
# got pem, fingerprint matches security records
```

security-note (tied): posted to #security-ops: new kid 9f2d4a fingerprint verified by natalie and lee.

natalie: applying verifier hotfix: adding kid 9f2d4a to accepted_kids with TTL 900s. Pushing rollout to us-west-1 first.

incident-bot: Config change recorded: verifier.accepted_kids += 9f2d4a by natalie at 11:13 UTC

ryan: rolling update batch 1 deployed. Observability: token verify errors falling in targeted fleet.

natalie: error-rate per-minute: before 950, 5m after change ~60/min. user-facing 500s reduced significantly.

ops-bot: triggered replication job: jwks-replicator --repair --service auth --regions us-west-1,eu-central --sync-now

lee: replicator logs show the worker in us-west-1 crashed due to file descriptor leak; restart succeeded and full JWKS now contains kid 9f2d4a across mirrors.

natalie: verifying caches across nodes:
```bash
for n in auth-prod-west-{10..15}; do ssh $n 'jq .keys[].kid /var/cache/jwks/auth.json' || echo fail:$n; done
# output shows 9f2d4a present on all nodes
```

natalie: scheduling rollback of the hot-accept at 11:35 UTC after validation window. setting alert to re-open if errors > 1% after rollback.

jon-manag: have CS publish a short status update: "Authentication issues affecting some users in US-West due to token key replication; mitigation in progress."

ops-bot: Status page updated by maya-support: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/8721

ryan: post-rollback check: removing temporary kid at 11:35
```json
{"verifier": {"accepted_kids_blacklist": [], "temporary_added_kids": [], "temp_accept_ttl": 0}}
```

incident-bot: Change recorded: temporary kid removed by ryan at 11:35 UTC

natalie: monitoring for 20m. metrics look stable; error-rate steady ~0.3%.

lee: remediation tasks created: AUTH-REP-450 (fix fd leak and add watchdog for replicator), AUTH-ALERT-230 (alert for kid divergence across mirrors), AUTH-TEST-77 (add smoke test to rotation pipeline). assigned to infra (lee) and platform (natalie).

jon-manag: customer impact summary: approx 6-9% auth failures for ~29 minutes in us-west-1, primarily mobile clients; no tokens compromised, new key validated and authorized. Customers A and D notified.

natalie: filing initial postmortem notes and will attach logs. plan to produce full postmortem by EOD.

pagerduty-bot: INC-8721 status changed to RESOLVED by natalie at 11:58 UTC (duration 51m)

jon-manag: thanks team. include timeline + playbook change to prefer automatic replication health check for key rotations.
